title: Add safety clamps for mesh indices and GPU error checks after draw
purpose: Catch and prevent silent GPU failures by clamping indices and checking for device loss after submissions in debug builds.

steps.detail: In particle_mesh.mesh, clamp vertexIndex and primitive indices to allocated ranges using particlesInWorkgroup. Avoid writing indices when particleIndex >= pc.particleCount.

In Application::drawFrame (or submission site), in debug builds call vkGetDeviceProcAddr for vkDeviceWaitIdle on fatal error paths and log VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST if submit/present fails. Add asserts that command buffer is inside rendering scope when calling vkCmdDrawMeshTasksEXT.

acceptance: No silent exits; any device loss is logged with explicit error code
